title: imap config test: new bcrypt error suffix '(cost must be 4-31)' not asserted
description: imap/src/config.rs test auth_users_plaintext_password_is_validation_error asserts msg.contains('auth.users[alice]') but does not assert the new '(cost must be 4-31)' suffix added in commit 8cf8dd7. If the suffix is removed or typo'd in a future edit, no test catches it. The reader config test has the same gap (asserts 'not a valid bcrypt hash' but not the suffix). A future contributor who silently drops the suffix gets a green test suite. Fix: add assert!(msg.contains('cost must be 4')) to both tests.
